Astra DB Serverless database regions and maintenance schedules

Contents

  • Request a region
  • AWS regions
  • Google Cloud regions
  • Microsoft Azure regions
  • Maintenance schedule
  • See also

Astra DB Serverless supports multiple Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure regions. Availability, pricing, and supported database types vary by region.

When you create a database, choose a region geographically close to your users for lower latency. If you need availability in multiple regions, see Deploy an Astra DB Serverless database to multiple regions .

Databases are triple replicated across three availability zones (AZ) within each region.

Request a region

DataStax adds new regions based on customer demand.

Restricted regions are available to approved customers based on credit consumption.

To request access to a new or restricted region, contact your DataStax account representative or IBM Support .

Maintenance schedule

DataStax routinely performs maintenance on Astra DB Serverless in each region. The following maintenance schedules are intended to avoid peak business hours and provide operational predictability to ensure the highest levels of service and reliability.

Maintenance schedules are ordered by day of the week and time, starting from Monday at 12 AM (UTC).

For information about regional maintenance events, go to Astra Regional Maintenance Status .
